page_content: This anti‑aging pure retinol face and neck serum leaves skin feeling smoother, hydrated, and renewed. As a result, the look of lines, wrinkles and premature sun damage is reduced. The formula combines concentrated pure + gradual‑release retinol with vitamin B3 (niacinamide) and glycerin for optimal efficacy and tolerance—even on sensitive skin. Lightweight, hydrating texture helps improve skin tone and texture. Dermatologist- and allergy-tested, oil‑free, non‑comedogenic, with a hint of fragrance. Use in the evening on face and neck, follow with moisturizer and daily SPF. Key ingredients: pure retinol for cell turnover; niacinamide to soothe and brighten; hyaluronic acid and glycerin for hydration; La Roche‑Posay thermal spring water. Consumer studies report 96% say skin feels softer, 90% see skin refined, 82% see younger-looking skin. Formulated and tested for sensitive skin types. Avoid use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
